thread:
Aisha Khan: hey team — new hire runs the quickstart and the first SDK call returns 403 billing_required. they say the web UI shows the workspace but the sample app logs 'workspace inactive'. any quick checks?

Drew Bell: can you paste the exact curl or snippet (mask token)?

Aisha Khan: curl they used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{"model":"gpt-4-redwood","input":"hello"}'
```
Response: `{\"error\":\"billing_required\",\"message\":\"Workspace billing not enabled\"}`

Marta Ruiz: common culprits: (1) the token is scoped to a different workspace that is unpaid, (2) CLI or local config has an old workspace_id cached, (3) the workspace was created by infra/SSO and needs an admin to enable billing.

Aisha Khan: they accepted the invite and can see their user in the Members list. UI Billing card shows 'no payment method' and 'pending'.

Infra Bot: automated check — workspace ws_7d9: created via invite, no active payment method, pending invoice count 0. service token used: token_abc is scoped to ws_7d9.

Drew Bell: that explains it — token-scoped workspace wins over REDWOOD_WORKSPACE_ID. run `redwood tokens inspect <token>` or `curl /v1/whoami` with the token to confirm.

Aisha Khan: ran `curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/whoami | jq .workspace_id` and it printed ws_7d9. So the token points at the unpaid workspace.

Marta Ruiz: quick unblock: create a personal sandbox workspace via Profile -> Create workspace and issue a personal API key, or have an org admin add a card / assign billing owner for ws_7d9. For fast dev, personal sandbox + set REDWOOD_API_KEY works.

Aisha Khan: admin added a payment method. retried sample — first successful response returned:
```json
{"id":"rsp_01","status":"ok","output":"hi"}
```

Aisha Khan: doc notes: - token workspace overrides env REDWOOD_WORKSPACE_ID - CI/infra-created workspaces often lack billing by default; add a provisioning checklist item - CLI cache (~/.redwood/config) can mislead; include `redwood whoami` and `redwood login --force` in troubleshooting - 403 currently returns billing_required; we should add a direct link to Console -> Billing and a one-liner next step in the payload body.

Drew Bell: filing DX ticket to append a billing URL and helpful text to the billing_required response and to add a short tokens inspect snippet to quickstart docs.

DevEx Bot: Ticket created: DX-4721 — "billing_required: add console link + tokens inspect example"

Aisha Khan: cheers — new hire unblocked, closing thread.
